source_binding: Implementation, test and CMake/CTest wiring were committed before the final two runs; this validation file is a documentation follow-up. The working tree was clean when both recorded runs started.
scope: One bounded, deterministic DSR 6n scenario on the formal C++/Qt/fixed-ConPTY path: 80x24 primary screen, single session, no resize, alternate screen or scroll region; child writes AB + ESC[6n from home; independent expected reply ESC[1;3R comes from the existing core reply contract (reply_test.cpp), not from the product output.

commands.build: cmake --build build/query-reply --config Release --target qt_query_reply_test reply_test private_mode_test --parallel 2

inputs.child_source_decode: AB + ESC[6n written once from the primary-screen home position
inputs.expected_derivation: Existing confirmed core reply contract in experiments/core/reply_test.cpp: CSI 6n replies ESC[row;colR with 1-based row and column; the same test asserts ab + ESC[6n => ESC[1;3R. After two printable cells from home the protocol cursor is (0,2), so the literal expectation is ESC[1;3R.
inputs.diagnostic_distinct_reply_scope: Raw host control only; it is not product output and does not change query support.

recorded_observations.transport_decode: startup ESC[1t ESC[c ESC[?1004h ESC[?9001h (23 B) + AB + ESC[6n, then shutdown ESC[?1004l ESC[?9001l; the product capture includes shutdown, the raw stages were captured before close.
recorded_observations.silent_control: With the host silent the real child received no bytes and exited through its own 4 s timeout (42); the fixed ConPTY therefore did not answer the DSR query itself in this configuration.
recorded_observations.distinct_control: The host-written diagnostic value ESC[9;9R reached the child unchanged, proving the host -> ConPTY -> child write path.
recorded_observations.product_chain: SessionModel parsed the exact fixed source at transport offset 23, held the core cursor at (0,2) with primary row 0 = AB, and the real child received exactly ESC[1;3R; the child raw file and metadata cross-check, PID identity and cleanup all agree.

limitations: Single 80x24 primary-screen, single-session, home-start scenario; no resize, alternate screen, scroll region, wide/combining text, history, selection or Find.

Only the implemented DSR 6n query. DA1 stays strict-only/recovery-silent; DA2, OSC 10/11, bracketed paste and mouse/focus modes remain unimplemented or unverified; this slice adds no product query support.

The child enables ENABLE_VIRTUAL_TERMINAL_INPUT, which is the pinned ConPTY condition for passing unhandled CSI through to the child; non-VT-input children were not tested and their byte delivery is unknown.
No WindTerm original comparison and no real TUI consumption evidence (e.g. Vim continuing after the reply); #28 overall TUI matrix and #27/#29/#30 joint acceptance remain open.
Runs take about 4.5 s and are not performance or presentation measurements; presented_done is null.
